ian: Heads-up — ready to flip price_matrix_v2 from shadow -> live for Cohort B tomorrow 04:00 PT. Need signoffs on grandfathering rule, invoice previews, and vendor cost sync. Please ack by 10:00 PT.
marisol: Quick q — grandfathering: is this only for active subscriptions at cutoff or any usage within a grace window?
ian: Only active subscriptions created before cutoff. We plan a 14-day grace window for metered usage. Config we'll toggle: `grandfathering.window_days=14`.
jae: Can billing ops run a dry invoice for the top 5 customers in the cohort to check rounding/multipliers?
billing-bot: DryInvoiceRunner: Requested dry run for 5 accounts queued (job id 2412345678-DR1). Preview link: https://ci.internal/dry/2412345678-DR1 :mag_right:
priya: Legal signoff ✅ (terms change reviewed). Sales wants a short customer heads-up template — I'll draft and share.
leo: Vendor cost note — vendor-sheet shows GPU pass-through multiplier 0.9. Need confirmation from cloud vendor before we go live. @sasha can you ping them? :eyes:
sasha: Pinged vendor (sent COL-42). They confirmed rates will hold for the rollout window. Opened ticket to correct an input row in the sheet (COL-42).
ian: OK — loop: Jae, please run dry-invoice for 100 accounts if DR1 looks clean, ETA EOD. Marisol, please update deploy flag to `grandfathering.window_days=14` in the toggle config. Priya, drop the email template in #marketing for review. I will not flip until billing dry-run and vendor confirm.
marisol: On it. Also found an edge case: credits rounding in CSV export causing a -$0.00 line for some customers. Added a small fix to the preview script and re-ran DR1 locally.
jae: Starting the 5-account dry-run now, will escalate to 100 after we validate results. ETA ~2h, will post logs.
billing-bot: DryRun job 2412345678-DR1 completed: 5 accounts processed, no negative adjustments detected. Report: https://ci.internal/dry/2412345678-DR1/report :white_check_mark:
ian: Great. If DR1 checks out, proceed with 100-account dry-run. Target flip time still 04:00 PT tomorrow pending final ok. Everyone pls ack if you saw this. :thumbsup:
priya: Acked. I'll share email draft in 30m.
leo: Acked — vendor confirmed.
sasha: Acked — ticket COL-42 linked to the rollout checklist.
marisol: Acked. Will push the config change to canary after Jae's 100-run passes.
jae: 100-account dry-run queued (job 2412345678-DR2). ETA ~1h 45m. Will post results in thread.
billing-bot: Job queued: 2412345678-DR2. ETA 1h 45m.
ian: Thanks — will monitor. If DR2 is clean we flip at 04:00 PT and publish the customer note.
